notes.title: Make It Count DEMO is live!
notes.content:
Make It Count: DEMO is available!

Make It Count is a 1-3 players Co-op, post-apocalyptic, top-down shooter with roguelite elements.
As the last survivors of humanity, it is your duty to exterminate this filth from the infested earth. Set out on your mission and get stronger by finding various trinkets! Collect meaningful resources to unlock, upgrade weapons and classes. Quench your bloodlust by eradicating these abominations!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3536000/Make_It_Count_Demo/

What can you expect in the demo?

 All classes are available to try in this demo
 Attribute tree is fully available
 First map, The Offices is playable for this demo
 All special zombies are available except The Witch for this demo
 Base difficulty tier is available to play
 Some base weapons are available to try out. An assault rifle(some people's favorite, M4A1), a SMG, a shotgun and a baseball bat(to demolish zombies)


See you in the apocalypse, Survivors!

notes.title: Update v0.3.1.2
notes.content:
Bosses are now reachable via a portal stone before the boss room. Boss room can be left with the portal stone again. When playing Co-Op, boss rooms becomes unreachable after a short period of time before the encounter ends one way or another.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544404/0c793014a45546faab39e3fb327258bc8aa6ace5.png
Upon a player's death, the fight will become unjoinable for that player. We thought when playing co-op, dying and rejoining the fight constantly did not prove much of a challenge and now the portal stones act as a warning before reaching the boss.
 1 new cave added to the Comona Forest.
 Hunger and fatigue buffs added. Having %80-100 Hunger will now provide a %10 stamina regen boost to the players. Having %0-20 fatigue will provide a %10 speed bonus.

notes.title: Combat Overhaul Update v0.3.0
notes.content:
Added & Changed

 Movement with combat weapons have been changed.
 Dodging can now be used in 4 directions. Left dash, right dash, backstep and forward roll.
 Seamless attacking with melee weapons added.
 Trajectory added to ranged weapons. It can be toggled on/off with M3 and M4 buttons.
 Bolt has been added into the game. Crossbows now require bolt to fire. It can be crafted via the handcrafting panel. Bolts need to be equipped into the quiver slot on the character panel.
 Bolt projectile speed has been slightly increased.
 Two-Handed weapon damages increased slightly, One-Handed and Ranged weapon damages reduced slightly.
Mob HP's have been increased slightly.


 While using ranged weapons, only backstep can be used as a dodging option.
 While using tools, only forward roll can be used.


Fixes
Fixed a bug when changing buttons via the keybindings setting, the indicator for the key in-game would not change.

notes.title: Important Notice Regarding March!
notes.content:
Hello Hunters;
We have an important announcement to make.

Sky Games is a team of 3 developers. 2 of our team members(our programmer and model designer) will be away for 30 days, starting tomorrow to do their mandatory military service for their country.  So we won’t be able to make any updates or patches this month. 

However our map designer will continue his work on the 3rd map and hopefully it will release in May. Furthermore, we wanted to release the character customization update before this but we haven't had enough time for testing but it will be available within few days when we come back in the first week of April. 

We will continue our work without interruption in April as soon as our members come back from their service. Thank you for your understanding and being with us to this day with your support.

 Mob balancing.


Fixes

 Mobs will become immune while walking back to their original location after stopping their chase after the player.
 Repairing a mine will now give experience to every player in the session.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.9
notes.content:
Fixed a bug when loading a save game, some resources and bosses would not start their cooldown properly.
Fixed a bug where ores would not respawn properly.
Fixed a bug when two same items with durability dragged on top of each other in the inventory, would copy the durability of the dragged item.
Fixed a bug where day and night cycle would not progress.


-Dropped items on the ground will disappear now after a while.
-Exit portals are now available at the end of the dungeons regardless of whether the boss is killed or not.

notes.title: Bugfixes v0.1.8
notes.content:
Fixed a bug when the player dies while sleeping, the character would stuck.
Fixed a bug that the skill 'Travelling Cuts' would not deal any damage.
Fixed a bug that a certain boss would not use a certain spell sometimes.


Our major update implementations into the game caused the bug below

Fixed a bug that sleeping could not be interrupted without getting to %0 hunger.

notes.title: New Region Coming in January 2023!
notes.content:
Hello Hunters;
We are happy to announce, a fully playable new region will be releasing next month!

New update will include;

 New region.
 2 new main dungeons.
 A new cave and a mine.
 New weapons, armors, enemies, materials.
 2 New unique crafting machines.
 Rework to boss unique weapons about how to acquire them.

notes.title: Changes v0.1.7
notes.content:
In-game camera zoom added.
Camera angle can now be tilted to a lower degree.
While map is open, character controls are changed to be more smooth to move on the map.
Some butterflies now brings joy to the Comona Forest.

notes.title: Hotfixes&Changes v0.1.6
notes.content:
Fixed a bug when creatures in the Comona Forest sometimes become invincible.
Fixed a bug when sometimes joined players could not see the enemies in Comona Forest.
Fixed a bug when enemies drop items in dungeons, the items would disappear.
Fixed a bug when the player is in the ghost form, enemies would stop spawning.
Enemy crossbow animations improved. 


We are working on a bug where sometimes crossbow basic attacks go through enemies and sometimes creatures in the upper levels of the dungeons stay invincible and passive. (Work in progress)

notes.title: Hotfixes&Changes v0.1.5
notes.content:
Fixed a bug when the player is a ghost, could open panels from buttons.
Fixed a bug after killing a boss, joined players couldn't see the exit portal.
Fixed a bug when joined players craft a building, only the host would receive experience.
Fixed a bug when leaving the world in a dungeon after saving the game, ores would respawn.
Fixed a bug when destroying a pillar with a wall torch on, the torch would float.
Fixed a bug when players with different resolution monitors puts a marker on the map, the markers would appear somewhere else.
Sound effects for a particular boss fight improved.
Fatigue debuffs will now disappear when released as a ghost.

notes.title: Hotfixes and Changes v0.1.4
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where on some screen resolutions, the apply button was not showing. Pivot point for the apply button has been changed.
Fixed a bug when the player is a ghost, could not be able to walk on stairs.
Fixed a bug when the player dies with %100 fatigue debuffs and respawns, the debuffs would not go.
Mob spawn timers for the Comona forest has been updated.
Wall torch collider fixed for replace and destroy mode.
When hunger reaches '0' while sleeping, sleeping will be distrupted.
Rope now require 2 Yarns to craft.
Bandage now require 2 Fabrics to craft.
Bandages now heals overtime.(Was instantaneous)
Tooltips for some items and skill are updated.
Fatigue will now progress %20 slower.
Cursor is now more visible.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.1.3
notes.content:
Day 3 hotfixes;


Fixed a bug where rolling and punching at the same time caused the character to freeze sometimes.
Fixed a bug where growing farming crops and seeds could be duplicated indefinitely by joined players.
Fixed a bug when joining another player without selecting a character could cause the game to crash.
Light transition during day and night cycle improved visually.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.1.2
notes.content:
Hello Hunters,

Here is our second hotfixes.


Fixed a bug where hostile creatures HP bar would not show.
Fixed a bug when killing bear when the bear uses its skill caused the game to crash.
Item balances.
Added more skeletons to the Comona Forest's mountain area.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello Hunters,

Here is our day 1 hotfixes;


Fixed a bug where "Spinning Machine" and "Tannery" caused the save system to crash.
Fixed a bug where "Raw Alpha Meat" could not be cooked.
Fixed a bug where some stones in the Comona Forest mountain region could not be harvested.
Fixed a bug where sometimes when a player joins, overall diffuculty of the enemies would not increase.
Mob and weapon balancing.

notes.title: Lodventure Early Access Releasing on December 12!
notes.content:
Hello Hunters,

We are happy to announce that Lodventure early access is finally releasing on 12th of December.

Lodventure Early Access includes these contents on Day 1:
- CO-OP
- Comona Forest Region
- 2 main dungeons and 1 mini dungeon
- Mine System
- 3 types of weapons with unique skills
- Farming & Cooking

We have a Discord channel available for all your questions and for connecting with other hunters.
